name: Masters in the Shadows
detailed_description:
Game Features:

  • Play with others – up to 4 players per match.

  • Choose the path of an artifact Seeker in a mysterious city, or become a Hunter, catching Seekers. Depending on the chosen role, you can get rewarded for selling stolen goods or for the Seekers you caught.

  • Watch out for local threats: feral robots, mutated former residents, who were abandoned during evacuation, and possibly others... Matches are not only about your rivals - some locals can also get in the way.

  • Choose your playstyle – set up ambushes, lay traps, engage in stealth parkour and lockpicking, or go loud with a shotgun and make everyone tremble - it’s up to you.

  • Every match is unique – returning to the same location may reveal unexpected changes and surprises.
    Customize and decorate your room at the hotel, invite friends over, and throw parties. You can even adopt a pet!

  • Discover documents scattered around the town and piece together the mystery of what happened in Millertown 20 years ago.

  • Level up your character, compete with others, and earn a spot on the local Hall of Fame in the In Paris hotel lobby!

  • Finally, take part in community discussions and polls on our Steam page - players decide which new location or feature we’ll add in the next update!

Add to your wishlist and follow to stay updated!

About the game world

After a failed experiment on implementing a new type of nuclear energy, aimed to replace electricity, the experimental "wireless town" of Millertown was abandoned in the late 1950s.

However, 20 years later, interest related to this town arises again. A new generation of collectors is willing to pay pretty generously for any artifacts from the Millertown, which was once predicted to have a bright future but was unexpectedly sealed off behind concrete walls and forgotten for decades.

Well, where there's demand, supply follows. 

Adventurers, infiltrating Millertown and exploring its various locations searching for valuables to sell, formed a community of Artifact Seekers.

The U.S. government, observing the increasing number of unauthorized entries, but unwilling to draw public attention or use armed forces, creates a new role: a Hunter. Their task is to track and detain Seekers in the abandoned town.

The abandoned In Paris hotel, located in the town center, serves as a hub of the local underground community. Here, Seekers and Hunters maintain a neutral zone alongside traders, artifact dealers, and guides who know the town like the back of their hand and are willing to escort adventurers - for a not-so-modest fee.

A code of conduct is in force: no conflicts on hotel grounds, and any arrests must happen only if the target is caught red-handed within the town territory. For missions, both Seekers and Hunters wear masks and protective suits. Their suits provide radiation protection, while the masks conceal identities - helping to maintain peace in the safe zone. After all, no one knows exactly what individual they’re dealing with out in the field. Especially since some Hunters occasionally go out there searching for precious artifacts... and vice versa.

At the end of the day, everyone's here for the same reason. Hunters are chasing bounty rewards for each capture. Seekers are hunting treasure in hopes of a big payday. But both sides risk losing much more than they bargained for - because Millertown, as it turns out, is far from being deserted.

short_description: Become an artifact seeker or a hunter, tracking seekers in the abandoned American town of the 1950s - now inhabited by feral robots and mutated humans.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 10100F
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1650
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 15 Sequoia
  • Processor: M1 Pro or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: M1 Pro or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains mutated people. There are no sexual relationships in the game.
